notes: The shipwide soundboard is now the 1MC. Also fixes random disconnects during long operations: the keepalive was sent every 15 seconds against a relay that drops a connection after 30 seconds of silence from the client, so a single delayed timer — and a running game is more than enough to delay one — cost you the net. It now goes out every 5 seconds. And if a link does drop, FleetComm reconnects it on its own, backing off and staggering the attempts, restoring LSN ALL and TX ALL as it goes. To be clear, there is no idle or silence timeout: nobody talking for an hour has never been a problem and still isn't.
